title: K-ON!!: Keikaku!
justification: AniList 9734 (OVA, 1 episode from 2011-03-16) is AniDB 7307's special S3 Keikaku! (Plan!), aired 2011-03-16. AniList's PARENT relation names AniList 7791, which anime-offline-database links to AniDB 7307, and the special's title matches AniList's romaji and English titles (Keikaku! and Plan!). The parent's row places S3 on TVDB 0x17 Plan! (2011-03-16) and, with the TMDB row, on TMDB 42253 S0E21 Plan! (2011-03-16).
